button.availableTitle: GoodGood {version} is available. Click to see what's new

dialog.empty: No release notes to show here; see the releases on GitHub.
dialog.language: Some of these release notes are only available in English.

dialog.portable: The portable version doesn't update automatically. Download the new version from the release page.

service.title: Update the privileged service?
service.body: The privileged service is version {serviceVersion}, which doesn't match GoodGood {version}. Some features may not work. Updating requires administrator permission.
service.bodyOlder: The privileged service is an older version that isn't compatible with GoodGood {version}. Until it's updated, actions that need administrator rights (ending processes of administrators or other accounts, managing system services, closing network connections and so on) can't be completed, and data the service provides, such as per-process network traffic, isn't shown. Updating requires administrator permission.
